question: How are the escalated quote-fidelity findings adjudicated, given their uniform sub-structures?
ruling: Three sub-classes, per the wave-sprint evidence pattern (rendered page quotes opus-verified verbatim-faithful; stored lake pinpoint records corrupt): (i) HARVEST-ARTIFACT stored-pin (stored quote is content-page markdown/prose, often containing '## Issue'/'## Rule' or frontmatter headers; lake marks quote_fidelity=mismatch) -> MODIFIED: defect real in the stored pinpoint record, severity reduced to the class level because the rendered quotation is faithful; ONE class-wide P3 re-harvest fix (runbook class (a)). (ii) TYPOGRAPHY-ONLY (straight vs typographic quotes/apostrophes, dash normalization, properly-marked ellipses) -> DISMISSED: normalization is not a fidelity defect under the corpus quoting convention; no unsupported proposition is published. (iii) PIN-DRIFT (displayed or stored pincite targets a page one off / wrong star marker while the quote itself is verbatim) -> MODIFIED: retarget the pin per the finding's proposed fix. Anything not matching a sub-class stays individually adjudicated.

evidence.ref: OPUS-LANE-RUNBOOK recurring defect class (a): corrupt harvested pinpoint.quote = content-page markdown; rendered quotes verbatim-faithful; low-severity class-wide re-harvest
escalate 1-1-1s here arise from lens-B out-of-lens refusals projecting as refuted; the two substantive lenses agree the stored record is defective and the rendered quote faithful

scope: P2 escalate queue quote-fidelity findings only.
